title: TV, Film & Music
content:
TV, Film & Music
Are you a pro at pop culture? Do your friends always turn to you when they can't remember what a song lyric is? Or what the name of Ross Geller's ex-wife was? If so, you'll want to try a few of our entertainment quizzes.
Learn More
TV theme songs become familiar friends, signaling the arrival of your favorite shows each week. If you watch a show through its entire run, you might find yourself listening to a certain theme song hundreds of times, but even casual viewers of a show can't help but hum along to catchy tunes. Take our quiz to see how much you remember about the most unforgettable TV theme songs of the '60s!
By Bambi Turner
The greatest musicals live-on in pop culture, thanks to catchy songs and over-the-top performances, but the most memorable productions combine these toe-tapping tunes with effective storytelling and quality plots.
Are you the biggest film nerd this side of the Mississippi? Do you know popular movies better than you know yourself? Take this quiz now to put your cinephile skills to the test!
By J.P. Naomi
Advertisement
Think you know this '90s classic? Prove it! Fill in the blanks and show us just how many "Clueless" quotes you know by heart. Let's see what you've got!
By Katie Ormsby
How well do you know Maude, the Nihlists, Walter Sobchak, Donnie, and, of course, The Dude? Test your knowledge of the 1990s cult hit, and perhaps you too can be a Little Lebowski Urban Achiever!
By John Payne
"Jaws" tore apart movie history the way a Great White rips through flesh. This is the movie that sparked worldwide fear in one of Earth's most terrifying predators. Were you able to keep your eyes open through the whole movie? Take this quiz to see how much you remember!
By Jodi C.
Is it all right? Are you saved by the bell? Follow Zack, Kelly, and the rest of the gang while you take on this quiz about high school life in the '80s and '90s.
By Kelly Scott
Advertisement
Let's see how much you remember about the main characters from "Friends" and those who come in and out of their lives, from the ten seasons of this award-winning sitcom.
Do you know your "Legally Blonde" from your "House Bunny"? What about the difference between "10 Things I Hate About You" and "How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days"? Test your knowledge of chick flicks past and present by identifying these single-sentence summarizations!
By Ashley Linkletter
"Grease" is a beloved movie featuring some of the most iconic characters in pop culture history. How much do you remember about this high school musical?
By Lenore Brown
Think you can get an A+ on this "10 Things I Hate About You" quiz? We certainly hope you don't get overwhelmed, underwhelmed or just plain whelmed! Show us how well you know this '90s classic.
By Katie Ormsby
Advertisement
Paging all handsome doctors to the ER! "ER" was a popular '90s drama TV series that showed everyone the inner dynamics of what it was like to be an emergency room doctor from emergency situations to personal lives. How much do you remember about this popular series?
By J.P. Naomi
The colorful costumes. The catchy show tunes. What's not to love about a boisterous big-screen musical? But how many of the following can you identify from one single screenshot?
By Jane Andrews
Dwayne Johnson, also known as The Rock, is proof that wrestling icons can be showmen on film just as much as they are in the ring. Dwayne is a blockbuster actor in Hollywood, with a massive following. But, like many actors, he started in smaller roles. Take this quiz to see how many of these Dwayne Johnson films you can name from just a screenshot.
By J. Scott Wilson
Are you an inquisitive and carefree Wei Wuxian? A serious but loyal Lan Wangji? Do you cause fear in others like the Ghost General? Which sect follows the path you wish to cultivate? Take the quiz and find out!
By Ian Fortey
Advertisement
So he's a murderer ... Still better than most of the dudes on Tinder! Now that you've binged "You" on Netflix, take our quiz to reveal how your relationship with the sexy yet creepy Joe Goldberg would end!
By Alex Wittman
Could you stand The Drip if you stayed at the Rosebud Motel? As The Motel Guest, you should tell us all about your Motel Review so that we guess can which Jazzagal or Jazzaguy you really are!
By Ashley Linkletter
Whether they're on the prowl for a serial killer or playing a demonic board game, nothing is what it seems for the residents of Riverdale. So if you were to live there, would you be more of a Betty or a Veronica? Take the quiz to find out!
By Amanda Monell
Are you ready to take a journey into the world of old-school cinema? This visual quiz will test your knowledge of the most beloved black-and-white movies in history. Only a true film aficionado will be able to ace it!
By Jane Andrews
Advertisement
Nelson Mandela's death sparked a phenomenon that would create what we know today as the Mandela Effect. Have you studied up on your false memories? If you think you can figure them out, get ready to test yourself!
By Heather Cahill
Does your ideal dad have the sarcastic wit of Tony Stark? Is he brave and confident like Captain Steve Rogers? Or is he the kind of guy who loses his cool and just Hulks out? It's time to find out who your Marvel dad. It'll be a snap!
By Ian Fortey
Do you crave the adventure of a galaxy far, far away? Do you fear the aliens with names you can't say? Do you want to go on a trek through the stars today? If you consider yourself a true sci-fi fan, it's time to boldly go where no one has gone before right into this quiz!
By Ian Fortey
Yoda's not the only "Star Wars" character who looks adorable as a little one! It's time to show your love for "Star Wars" by naming these characters when they're wide-eyed, sweet-faced tots!
By Brittany Rowland
Advertisement
Oh no! The Disney ball is about to begin, and you've got no dress for you to wear! If you help us create a magical gown from scratch, then we'll reveal which Disney Princess you're exactly like!
By Talin Vartanian
In the world of comics, you're either a hero or a villain. Unless you're an anti-hero like Deadpool. Or you flip-flop like Mystique. Or you were brainwashed like the Winter Soldier. Identifying all the heroes and villains in this quiz might be harder than it seems, but try it and see!
By Ian Fortey
